rule: Sun in the 1st house (self, temperament, how things begin)
text: The Sun in the 1st house, the whole sign rising at birth, is read for how identity is presented and how things are begun. The placement tends to show up as a visible, self-assured presence that takes charge of its own affairs and expects to be noticed. Vitality and pride both colour first impressions. The reflective question is how authority over one's own life is shared with others.

rule: Sun in the 2nd house (speech, values, savings, family resources)
text: The Sun in the 2nd house is read for how self-worth, speech and resources are connected. The placement tends to show up as confident, authoritative speech and a sense of identity tied to what one earns, owns and values. Family standing matters. It is read for how pride in provision is balanced with generosity and how one's word is used.

rule: Sun in the 3rd house (effort, courage, siblings, skills, short journeys)
text: The Sun in the 3rd house is read for personal effort, courage and the way skills and communication are developed. The placement tends to show up as initiative in writing, learning and local dealings, and a leading role among siblings and peers. Confidence grows through doing. It is read for how enterprise is sustained and how one's own voice is found.

rule: Sun in the 4th house (home, parents, property, inner peace)
text: The Sun in the 4th house is read for home, parents, property and the sense of inner settledness. The placement tends to show up as a strong identification with family background and a wish to be a central figure at home. Private life carries public weight. It is read for how authority within the household is exercised with warmth.

rule: Sun in the 5th house (creativity, children, intelligence, learning)
text: The Sun in the 5th house is read for creative expression, intelligence, children and the joy of learning. The placement tends to show up as pride in one's ideas and creations, a natural teaching or performing manner and strong involvement with children or students. It is read for how creative confidence is shared and how others' contributions are credited.

rule: Sun in the 6th house (service, routines, work, obstacles, competition)
text: The Sun in the 6th house is read for daily work, service, routines and the way obstacles and competition are met. The placement tends to show up as identity invested in being useful and in overcoming difficulties through effort; rivals sharpen rather than deter. It is read for how a sense of self survives criticism and how discipline is held steadily.

rule: Sun in the 7th house (partnership, marriage, public dealings)
text: The Sun in the 7th house is read for partnership, marriage and dealings with the public and with equals. The placement tends to show up as a strong need to be recognised within relationships and a tendency to meet confident, self-directed partners. Negotiation becomes a stage for identity. It is read for how two centres of authority make room for each other.

rule: Sun in the 8th house (transformation, hidden matters, shared resources, research)
text: The Sun in the 8th house is read for transformation, what is hidden, shared resources and depth of inquiry. The placement tends to show up as a self that is reserved about its core, drawn to research or private work and reshaped by major changes. Recognition may come quietly. It is read for how identity is rebuilt after endings and how privacy is kept.

rule: Sun in the 9th house (beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning, long journeys)
text: The Sun in the 9th house is read for beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning and long journeys. The placement tends to show up as an identity rooted in principles and tradition, respect for mentors and a wish to guide others in turn. Faith is held with confidence. It is read for how conviction stays open to question and how guidance is given without preaching.

rule: Sun in the 10th house (career, public role, action, authority)
text: The Sun in the 10th house is read for career, public role and the exercise of authority. The placement tends to show up as ambition for a visible position, a natural ease with responsibility and a reputation that matters a great deal. Work defines much of the self. It is read for how public standing is pursued with integrity and how private life is protected.

rule: Sun in the 11th house (gains, friends, networks, aspirations)
text: The Sun in the 11th house is read for gains, friendships, wider networks and long-term aspirations. The placement tends to show up as leadership within groups, influential friends and goals that reach beyond immediate comfort. Recognition from peers is valued. It is read for how a prominent role among friends is held generously and how aspirations are shared.

rule: Sun in the 12th house (rest, expenses, distant places, solitude, letting go)
text: The Sun in the 12th house is read for rest, expenditure, distant places, solitude and release. The placement tends to show up as an identity that works best behind the scenes, abroad or in private, and that recharges in seclusion. Recognition may feel elusive. It is read for how a quiet self is honoured and how retreat is used for renewal rather than avoidance.

It is read for how sensitivity becomes a resource and how a stable centre is kept amid change.

rule: Moon in the 4th house (home, parents, property, inner peace)

rule: Moon in the 6th house (service, routines, work, obstacles, competition)

rule: Moon in the 8th house (transformation, hidden matters, shared resources, research)

rule: Moon in the 12th house (rest, expenses, distant places, solitude, letting go)

text: Saturn in the 9th house is read for beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning and long journeys. The placement tends to show up as faith tested by experience, respect for tradition held with reservations, disciplined study and a serious relationship with teachers and elders. Doubt is part of belief. It is read for how conviction is earned and how philosophy becomes practice.

rule: Saturn in the 10th house (career, public role, action, authority)
text: Saturn in the 10th house, where it is classically strong, is read for career, public role and authority. The placement tends to show up as ambition pursued through long, disciplined effort, a reputation for reliability and responsibility accepted and carried steadily. Recognition tends to come later and last. It is read for how authority is held with fairness and warmth.

rule: Saturn in the 11th house (gains, friends, networks, aspirations)
text: Saturn in the 11th house is read for gains, friendships, networks and aspirations. The placement tends to show up as a small, enduring circle of friends, gains that accumulate through steady effort and aspirations pursued over long periods with realism. Loyalty outlasts popularity. It is read for how commitment to a few people and goals is kept open to new ones.

rule: Saturn in the 12th house (rest, expenses, distant places, solitude, letting go)
text: Saturn in the 12th house is read for rest, expenses, distant places, solitude and release. The placement tends to show up as comfort in solitude and disciplined practice, controlled expenditure, work behind the scenes or far from home and a slow learning of how to let go. Quiet is productive. It is read for how retreat is structured and how rest is allowed.

rule: Rahu in the 1st house (self, temperament, how things begin)
text: Rahu in the 1st house is read for identity and self-presentation, which the north node amplifies and makes unconventional. The placement tends to show up as a striking or unusual presence, strong ambition to define oneself and a self-image that keeps being reinvented. Being ordinary is not the goal. It is read for how a large appetite for self-expression is grounded.

rule: Rahu in the 2nd house (speech, values, savings, family resources)
text: Rahu in the 2nd house is read for speech, values and resources, amplified and made unconventional by the north node. The placement tends to show up as a strong drive toward wealth, unusual earning paths, striking speech and values that depart from the family's. The appetite for more is strong. It is read for how enough is recognised and how speech is used.

rule: Rahu in the 3rd house (effort, courage, siblings, skills, short journeys)
text: Rahu in the 3rd house is read for effort, courage, skills and communication, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as bold initiative, fascination with media, technology and new skills, many short journeys and unconventional ties with siblings. Daring comes easily. It is read for how restless ambition is channelled into finished work.

rule: Rahu in the 4th house (home, parents, property, inner peace)
text: Rahu in the 4th house is read for home, parents, property and inner peace, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as a strong wish for property and domestic security, homes far from where one was raised and an unusual family story. Inner peace is sought actively. It is read for how belonging is built where one actually lives.

rule: Rahu in the 5th house (creativity, children, intelligence, learning)
text: Rahu in the 5th house is read for creativity, intelligence, children and learning, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as unconventional creative ambitions, fascination with speculation, performance or novel ideas and distinctive bonds with children or students. Originality is the aim. It is read for how creative hunger is given discipline and shared.

rule: Rahu in the 6th house (service, routines, work, obstacles, competition)
text: Rahu in the 6th house is read for work, service, routines and the way obstacles and competition are met, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as an appetite for demanding work, skill in unusual fields and rivals who are outmanoeuvred rather than confronted. Problems are a stimulus. It is read for how competitiveness serves service.

rule: Rahu in the 7th house (partnership, marriage, public dealings)
text: Rahu in the 7th house is read for partnership, marriage and public dealings, amplified and made unconventional by the north node. The placement tends to show up as partners from a different background or culture, strong attraction to relationship itself and public dealings that break the usual pattern. Expectations run high. It is read for how the hunger for connection is met honestly.

rule: Rahu in the 8th house (transformation, hidden matters, shared resources, research)
text: Rahu in the 8th house is read for transformation, hidden matters, shared resources and research, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as fascination with what is hidden, with deep research and with how things really work, unusual experiences of change and strong interest in others' resources. Mystery attracts. It is read for how intensity is approached with discernment.

rule: Rahu in the 9th house (beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning, long journeys)
text: Rahu in the 9th house is read for beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning and long journeys, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as attraction to foreign philosophies and places, unconventional teachers and a faith adopted rather than inherited. Belief is an adventure. It is read for how enthusiasm for new ideas is tested and settled.

rule: Rahu in the 10th house (career, public role, action, authority)
text: Rahu in the 10th house is read for career, public role and authority, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as strong ambition for status and visibility, careers in new or unconventional fields and a public image that is larger than the private self. Fame has appeal. It is read for how worldly ambition is anchored in substance.

rule: Rahu in the 11th house (gains, friends, networks, aspirations)
text: Rahu in the 11th house is read for gains, friendships, networks and aspirations, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as wide, unusual networks, friends from many backgrounds, gains through technology or novel ventures and large aspirations. The circle is always growing. It is read for how breadth of connection is matched with loyalty.

rule: Rahu in the 12th house (rest, expenses, distant places, solitude, letting go)
text: Rahu in the 12th house is read for rest, expenses, distant places, solitude and release, amplified by the north node. The placement tends to show up as strong attraction to foreign lands, the imagination and the inner life, unusual spending and a restless search for peace. Escape has appeal. It is read for how retreat becomes renewal and how limits are kept.

rule: Ketu in the 1st house (self, temperament, how things begin)
text: Ketu in the 1st house is read for identity and self-presentation, which the south node detaches from and makes familiar. The placement tends to show up as an understated presence, little interest in self-promotion and a sense of self that is intuitive rather than constructed. Others may find this person hard to read. It is read for how identity is claimed without ego.

rule: Ketu in the 2nd house (speech, values, savings, family resources)
text: Ketu in the 2nd house is read for speech, values and resources, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as indifference to accumulation, sparing or unusual speech, values that sit apart from the family's and an ease with simplicity. Possessions are held lightly. It is read for how material life is tended without either greed or neglect.

rule: Ketu in the 3rd house (effort, courage, siblings, skills, short journeys)
text: Ketu in the 3rd house is read for effort, courage, skills and communication, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as courage that is quiet and unforced, little interest in self-promotion or chatter and relations with siblings that are distant or unusual. Skills feel innate. It is read for how initiative is reclaimed when it is called for.

rule: Ketu in the 4th house (home, parents, property, inner peace)
text: Ketu in the 4th house is read for home, parents, property and inner peace, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as a loose relationship with place and property, a home that is simple or often changed and an inner stillness sought rather than inherited. Roots are inward. It is read for how belonging is allowed and how home is made anywhere.

rule: Ketu in the 5th house (creativity, children, intelligence, learning)
text: Ketu in the 5th house is read for creativity, intelligence, children and learning, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as intuitive intelligence, little need for applause in creative work, an unusual or hands-off bond with children or students and learning that seems to arrive ready-made. It is read for how creative joy is claimed consciously.

rule: Ketu in the 6th house (service, routines, work, obstacles, competition)
text: Ketu in the 6th house is read for work, service, routines and the way obstacles and competition are met, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as little appetite for rivalry, service given without fuss and routines that are either ignored or followed intuitively. Problems resolve quietly. It is read for how daily discipline is kept deliberately.

rule: Ketu in the 7th house (partnership, marriage, public dealings)
text: Ketu in the 7th house is read for partnership, marriage and public dealings, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as self-sufficiency in relationship, partners who are reflective, unusual or undemanding and little interest in the public dimension of partnership. Independence feels natural. It is read for how commitment is chosen rather than drifted into.

rule: Ketu in the 8th house (transformation, hidden matters, shared resources, research)
text: Ketu in the 8th house is read for transformation, hidden matters, shared resources and research, where the south node is classically at ease. The placement tends to show up as a calm familiarity with endings and depth, intuitive insight into what is hidden and indifference to joint finances or inheritance. Mystery feels like home. It is read for how depth is lived without drama.

rule: Ketu in the 9th house (beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning, long journeys)
text: Ketu in the 9th house is read for beliefs, teachers, elders, higher learning and long journeys, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as scepticism toward formal religion and teachers, a personal rather than inherited philosophy and little pull toward travel for its own sake. Wisdom feels innate. It is read for how one's own faith is articulated and lived.

rule: Ketu in the 10th house (career, public role, action, authority)
text: Ketu in the 10th house is read for career, public role and authority, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as little hunger for status, work pursued for its own sake or behind the scenes and an uneasy relationship with titles and public image. Ambition is private. It is read for how a vocation is claimed deliberately and shared.

rule: Ketu in the 11th house (gains, friends, networks, aspirations)
text: Ketu in the 11th house is read for gains, friendships, networks and aspirations, which the south node detaches from. The placement tends to show up as a small circle, little interest in networking or popularity, gains that arrive without being chased and aspirations that are inward rather than social. Few friends, deep ones. It is read for how contribution to the wider circle stays alive.

rule: Ketu in the 12th house (rest, expenses, distant places, solitude, letting go)
text: Ketu in the 12th house is read for rest, expenses, distant places, solitude and release, where the south node is classically at ease. The placement tends to show up as natural comfort in solitude, meditation and letting go, indifference to expenditure and a rich inner life that others rarely see. Retreat is effortless. It is read for how inner peace is connected to daily life.
